title: Nilabati Behera v State of Orissa

content.caseIdentity: Nilabati Behera v State of Orissa, (1993) 2 SCC 746
content.facts: Sovereign-immunity principles in private law must be distinguished from constitutional compensation for established fundamental-rights violations.
